Wait for fuzz test and full test suite to complete.
Added `Encode(w io.Writer) error` and `Decode(r io.Reader) error` on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex.go#L418-L445) on branch `shapeindex-encode`.

### Summary of Changes
- **`ShapeIndex` Serialization** ([s2/shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex.go)):
  - Added [`(*ShapeIndex).Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex.go#L1408-L1486) and [`(*ShapeIndex).Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex.go#L1488-L1622).
  - Automatically builds pending index updates during `Encode` so indices encoded without an explicit `Build` serialize their complete spatial cell structure and decode in the `fresh` state ready for immediate queries and iteration.
  - Round-trips all built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shape.go#L230-L269) types (`*Polygon`, `*Polyline`, `*PointVector`, `*LaxPolygon`, `*LaxPolyline`, `*Loop`, `*LaxLoop`, plus generic/custom `Shape` implementations) while preserving shape IDs, `nextID` (including gaps from removed shapes), `maxEdgesPerCell`, `cells`, `cellMap`, and `clippedShape` entries (`shapeID`, `containsCenter`, and `edges`).
  - Protects against truncated data, corrupted bytes, invalid structural references, and oversized allocation requests via strict bounds checking, chunked slice allocation, and a trailing IEEE CRC-32 checksum.
- **Shape & Index Fixes**:
  - Fixed [`PointVector.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/point_vector.go#L38) to index by chain `i` rather than chain offset `j`.
  - Fixed [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/lax_loop.go#L74-L80) wrap-around condition on the final vertex.
  - Fixed [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/lax_polygon.go#L166-L176) offset calculation across multi-loop chains.
  - Hardened [`Loop.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/loop.go#L971-L1035), [`Polygon.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/polygon.go#L1014-L1066), and [`Polyline.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/polyline.go#L251-L275) against truncated inputs and oversized vertex/loop count allocations.
  - Updated [`ShapeIndex.applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex.go#L732-L779) and [`ShapeIndex.makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex.go#L1127-L1200) to support shape ID gaps after `Remove`.
- **Tests** ([s2/shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L677-L1062)):
  - Added tests covering empty indices, unbuilt indices, all built-in `Shape` types, zero-edge shapes, mixed chain counts, shape ID preservation with removals, and malformed/truncated/corrupted/oversized inputs, plus [`FuzzDecodeShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-smqzmlx7/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L1037-L1061).
